profile_text.body:
Thomson Reuters is a publicly traded global content and technology company headquartered in Toronto, listed on both Nasdaq and TSX under the ticker TRI, with a CIK of 0001075124. The company describes itself as delivering purpose-built technology to help professionals make faster decisions and gain sharper insights across legal, tax, trade, and risk domains. Its platform portfolio includes CoCounsel, which it describes as built on the principles of "Fiduciary-Grade AI" for legal professionals, integrating research, analysis, and drafting grounded in Westlaw and Practical Law content; ONESOURCE+, an AI-powered platform connecting tax, trade, legal, and risk workflows; and trade compliance tools offering AI-driven Harmonized System code classification for import and export. In August 2026 the company announced Thomson, described as its first proprietary large language model developed in-house, and reported that global law firm Greenberg Traurig, LLP had deployed the next generation of CoCounsel Legal.

The site highlights a customer case in which a firm called Justly Prudent used CoCounsel and Westlaw AI and reports the result as increasing litigation capacity by 100%. Thomson Reuters also publishes annual research on AI adoption, including its Future of Professionals Report 2026 and the 2026 AI in Professional Services Report, the latter drawing on perspectives from more than 1,500 professionals and covering the legal, tax, accounting, risk, fraud, and government sectors. The held facts show that CoCounsel, which traces to the Casetext acquisition, is the AI product tracked for Thomson Reuters on this site, noted for legal research, litigation support, Westlaw integration, and attorney work product risk considerations.
